d: Vanuatu is escalating its territorial dispute with France over Hunter Island and Matthew Island in the Pacific. The two islands are claimed by both Vanuatu and France, through its territory New Caledonia. Firstpost looks at both the nations' claims over the two volcanic rocks. Hem Kaur Saroya explains the importance of the Matthew and Hunter Islands, and the potential to exploit their Exclusive Economic Zone. HKS also looks at the new tactics Vanuatu is using to get France to give up these far-flung colonial possessions.
